asteroid_belt.desc: Dense asteroid field. Pirates and territorial fauna.
asteroid_belt.name: Asteroid Belt

lunar_orbit.desc: Low threat sector populated by rogue mining drones.
lunar_orbit.name: Lunar Orbit

mars_debris.desc: War-torn debris. Salvage mechs and derelict defenses.
mars_debris.name: Mars Debris Field

sector_beta.desc: Abandoned mining colony. Automated defense systems.
sector_beta.name: Sector Beta

sector_delta.desc: Crystal nebula. Prismatic entities and void anomalies.
sector_delta.name: Sector Delta

sector_epsilon.desc: Beyond known space. Primordial entities and temporal anomalies.
sector_epsilon.name: Sector Epsilon

sector_gamma.desc: Deep space void. Energy wraiths and exotic matter.
sector_gamma.name: Sector Gamma

sector_zeta.desc: Quarantine zone. Biological horrors and rogue AI.
sector_zeta.name: Sector Zeta

the_caustic_core.desc: The heart of the corrosion. The Caustic Sovereign opens and closes on Corrosion, Cryo between — the loop's capstone gate.
the_caustic_core.name: Sector 15 — The Caustic Core

the_dissolution.desc: Matter unravels here. The Dissolution Tyrant gates THREE phases — Cryo → Corrosion → Cryo — two swaps to breach.
the_dissolution.name: Sector 14 — The Dissolution

the_rift.desc: A corrosive tear in space. The Rift Warden hardens against Cryo, then Corrosion — breach each phase with the matching armament.
the_rift.name: Sector 12 — The Rift

the_threshold.desc: Warp-Hardened space. Hostiles are immune to conventional armaments — only Cryogenic weapons (unlocked by Warping) breach them.
the_threshold.name: The Threshold

the_verdigris.desc: Oxidized ruin where the corrosion took hold. The Verdigris Warden hardens Corrosion then Cryo — swap the other way this time.
the_verdigris.name: Sector 13 — The Verdigris Reach
